title: 18 Bishop Street, Newcastle West, Co. Limerick
seoTitle: 18 Bishop Street, Newcastle West, Co. Limerick
description:
4 Bedroom Furnished House with Extensive Private Parking – Newcastle West Town Centre

Spacious and well-presented four-bedroom furnished house located in the heart of Newcastle West town centre.

The property has recently been extensively refreshed and is ready for immediate occupation.

The accommodation is generously laid out over two floors and comprises three double bedrooms and one single bedroom. The single bedroom is located on the ground floor, with three double bedrooms upstairs.

The ground floor also includes a comfortable separate sitting room, a large kitchen/dining room with solid-fuel stove, separate utility room, guest WC and an additional shower room with shower, WC and washbasin.

Upstairs are three double bedrooms together with the main family bathroom, which includes a bath, separate shower, WC and washbasin.

The property is fully furnished and equipped. The kitchen includes a dishwasher, while the separate utility room has a washing machine and tumble dryer.

The house benefits from oil-fired central heating with a timer, along with the additional solid-fuel stove in the kitchen/dining area.

A particular feature of the property is the extensive secure private parking to the rear, with private lane access directly to the Market Yard. There is also a small storage shed to the rear.

The property offers generous living accommodation and excellent parking while being situated right in the centre of Newcastle West, convenient to shops, schools and local amenities.

Key Features

* 4 bedrooms – 3 double and 1 single
* Newcastle West town-centre location
* Extensive secure private parking
* Private rear lane access to the Market Yard
* Small storage shed
* Oil-fired central heating with timer
* Solid-fuel stove
* Main bathroom with bath and separate shower
* Additional shower room with WC
* Separate guest WC
* Large kitchen/dining room
* Separate sitting room
* Separate utility room
* Dishwasher
* Washing machine and tumble dryer
* Fully furnished
* Available immediately

Rent: €2,500 per month.
